operation: A-202 M3.5 = 3-5/8" studs SISTERED TO EXISTING FRAMING (one metal stud per existing stud) + A-202 note D.1 'see structural for stud spacing' + S-101 foundation note 4 'ALL PERIMETER AND SHEAR WALLS ARE 2x6 SYP @ 16" O.C. TYPICAL U.N.O.' + D1/S-601 'EXISTING 2x6 @ 16" O.C.' => M3.5 spacing = 16" O.C.
source: M3.5/A-202 (wall type schedule) + D.1/A-202 + note 4/S-101 (A1 Foundation Notes) + D1/S-601

answer: Bridging LOCATION is printed (MID SPAN for spans 0-17 ft, THIRD SPAN 17-20.5 ft, A2/S-241). The bridging MEMBER for the LGS ceiling joists is not printed.
source: A2/S-241 (location only); nearest printed: C2/S-801 '33 MIL CONT. BLKG. AS REQ'D' at ceiling joists (at wall line); S-902 C05400 3.4.E.2 bridging = cold-rolled steel channel (for wall studs only)
why_not_printed: A2/S-241 LGS schedule has a 'BRIDGING LOCATION' column only. The S-241 C3 plan draws no bridging line and no member (the '*' marks are 2x4 blocking at fixtures). S-902 C05400 only covers load-bearing and exterior non-load-bearing WALL framing (1.1.A); its bridging types (3.3.I / 3.4.E: CR channel, strap + solid blocking, proprietary bars) are for wall studs. C09111 (A-909) has no joist bridging. C2/S-801 '33 mil cont. blkg as req'd' is at the wall line, not mid-span. The 1-1/2" CRC loaded now matches S-902 type 'cold-rolled steel channel' by analogy only.

operation: A-221: Service/Kitchen C.H. 10'-2" around the walk-ins; KN2 'metal closure panels above freezer and cooler, install after ceiling grid is in place' => the walk-ins close up to the 10'-2" grid, so the 'finish ceiling' of G.11 is 10'-2"; 10'-2" + 0'-6" = 10'-8".
